_about: Dodgy Del: a 12-year-old in sunglasses with a stall made of a pram. Names and blurbs for what he sells (prices live in balance.json shop.prices), and his bad jokes (one per visit).

burp_blaster.name: Burp Blaster
burp_blaster.blurb: A burp so big it knocks everyone near you over.

jokes: Why did the cake go to the doctor? It was feeling crummy. ...No refunds.
Everything's legit. Mostly. Don't ask where the pram's from.
What do you call a sleeping supermarket guard? A security blanket. Heh.
Water balloons! Guaranteed wet or your sweets back. Not really.
I'd tell you a joke about the tills, but it wouldn't check out.
Three kids in a coat. Classic. My nan does that.
Buy two, get... two. That's maths.

reroll: Let me check under the pram...
New stock! Fell off a lorry.
